title: TikTok rules
keywords: tiktok timeslot afternoon evening penalty late pickup $15 wrong status repost weight 30kg stacking 4 hours
body: 100% fulfilment; no TikTok job is ever moved to the next day — if capacity is short, outsource.
Afternoon: pickup 3–6.30pm, delivery 3.30–7.30pm. Evening: pickup 5.30–8pm, delivery 6.30–10.30pm.
Delivery deadline: 4 hrs from pickup. Over 4 hrs is a breach regardless of timeslot.
Penalties: late pickup $15/job; wrong status update $15/job (recovered from the agent).
Max 30 kg / 200 cm; over- or under-declared → raise to TikTok at once. Max 10 drops per slot unless subcon/regular driver.
Never repost in admin — the TikTok API reposts. If a cancellation was valid, flag it to TikTok and delete the job in admin when told.
